nodes.label: Mobile E2E (Maestro) Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs .maestro/ suite on an iOS simulator against the LAN test server exposed via frp (public 6001/9001, not the other deployment on 3000). Requires macos-26/Xcode >= 26.4.1 (Swift 6.3) because Expo SDK 57 SPM packages fail to compile on Swift 6.2 (upstream expo/expo#47957, official fix is upgrading Xcode). Hermes dev builds ignore EXPO_PUBLIC_* and .env at runtime, so the only reliable config channel is injecting app.json extra at build time; DerivedData cache keys must cover native ios/ files to avoid stale ATS values; simulator boots async in parallel with the ~10min build and animations are disabled to reduce tap/cold-start flakes.
